title: Pteranodon screech (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by National Park Service
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (bald eagle and common raven calls, pitched down and layered). Sound design from 2 real recordings: "Bald Eagle (NPS Sound Gallery)" 0.18–1.20 s, high-passed at 500 Hz, slowed to 0.8× speed (pitched down 20%); "Common Raven (NPS Sound Gallery)" 3.38–3.80 s, high-passed at 400 Hz, slowed to 0.75× speed (pitched down 25%), placed at 1.20 s; "Common Raven (NPS Sound Gallery)" 4.48–4.85 s, high-passed at 400 Hz, slowed to 0.75× speed (pitched down 25%), placed at 1.75 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 120 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
